drop EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT [SynapseParquetFormatDedicated];

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.external_file_formats WHERE name = 'SynapseCsvFormatDedicated') 
	CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT [SynapseCsvFormatDedicated] 
	WITH ( FORMAT_TYPE = DELIMITEDTEXT ,
	       FORMAT_OPTIONS (
			 FIELD_TERMINATOR = ',',
			 FIRST_ROW = 11,
			 USE_TYPE_DEFAULT = FALSE
			))
GO

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.external_data_sources WHERE name = 'quant-container_quantcloudstorage_dfs_core_windows_net_dedicated') 
	CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE [quant-container_quantcloudstorage_dfs_core_windows_net_dedicated] 
	WITH (
		LOCATION = 'abfss://quant-container@quantcloudstorage.dfs.core.windows.net' 
	)
GO

-- drop EXTERNAL TABLE [dbo].[players];

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE [dbo].[players]
(
    [player_id] BIGINT,
    [first_name] NVARCHAR(100),
    [last_name] NVARCHAR(100),
    [name] NVARCHAR(200),
    [last_season] INT,
    [current_club_id] BIGINT,
    [player_code] NVARCHAR(200),
    [country_of_birth] NVARCHAR(100),
    [city_of_birth] NVARCHAR(100),
    [country_of_citizenship] NVARCHAR(100),
    [date_of_birth] DATETIME2,
    [sub_position] NVARCHAR(100),
    [position] NVARCHAR(100),
    [foot] NVARCHAR(20),
    [height_in_cm] INT,
    [contract_expiration_date] DATE,
    [agent_name] NVARCHAR(200),
    [image_url] NVARCHAR(1000),
    [international_caps] INT,
    [international_goals] INT,
    [current_national_team_id] BIGINT,
    [url] NVARCHAR(1000),
    [current_club_domestic_competition_id] NVARCHAR(20),
    [current_club_name] NVARCHAR(300),
    [market_value_in_eur] BIGINT,
    [highest_market_value_in_eur] BIGINT
)
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'Raw/players.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = [quant-container_quantcloudstorage_dfs_core_windows_net_dedicated],
    FILE_FORMAT = [SynapseCsvFormatDedicated]
);


select * from [dbo].[players];
